Hat Creek: Spring-Fed Trout Fishing in California

Spend a day after trout on spring-fed Hat Creek. Pick a section of this California water and enjoy fishing at the creek's pace.

About this water

The fishery source record for Hat Creek, United States, identifies Rainbow trout and brown trout (Salmo trutta).

Hat Creek's source context concerns trout, including rainbow and brown trout. Ask the local provider to identify a named access point and explain the presentation difficulty there. Discuss a simpler alternative if the selected water does not suit a beginner. Keep that choice separate from buying specialist tackle. The catalog's Salmo trutta label does not establish a sea-run outing, and the creek name alone does not settle access.

SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Ask which section and approach suit your dates; one creek name can cover different fishing experiences. Prioritize presentation practice and a manageable leader system over accumulating more fly patterns.

Choose a reach and presentation

A river name is not a complete day plan. Decide the reach, bank access and presentation first. Ask for the useful lure weight or fly-line arrangement, then match the rod, reel and leader to that answer. Wading is a separate decision and is not assumed in this brief.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for California

Anglers aged 16 or older generally need a sport fishing licence in fresh or ocean water. Children and public-pier anglers can still need species report cards.

  • 1 specified day$21.09 USD
  • 2 consecutive days$32.40 USD
  • 10 consecutive days$64.54 USD
  • 365 days$174.14 USD
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Rules for this water

  • From Lake Britton to Baum Lake, release all trout.
  • Use artificial lures with barbless hooks in that reach.
  • The special reach excludes the concrete Hat No. 2 intake canal.

Full California licence guide ↗ · Checked November 2026.
